sections.Description:
Embark on an unforgettable journey across four distinct habitats, discovering, catching, and bonding with many of their favorite Pokémon.

In Pokémon by Stern Pinball, Trainers embark on an unforgettable journey across four distinct habitats, discovering, catching, and bonding with many of their favorite Pokémon. The playfield features beautifully crafted Pokémon-themed ramps, spinners, and targets. Bringing the experience to life even further, custom voice work for Pikachu and the notorious Team Rocket leader, Giovanni, captures the spirit and humor that fans know and love. To complete the nostalgic journey, the game proudly includes the iconic “Pokémon Theme (Gotta Catch‘Em All)” song, a true celebration of the timeless Pokémon adventure.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- Pikachu Reacts: Watch as the animatronic Pikachu reacts to your gameplay, cheering you on every step of the way!
- Battle Team Rocket: Danger lurks as Team Rocket and their infamous boss, Giovanni, plot trouble. The interactive Meowth Balloon toy swoops down onto the battle arena to challenge the Trainer.
- Catch Pokémon: Players will shoot the illuminated, mechanically animated Poké Ball to catch Pokémon, build their ultimate team, and complete their Pokémon Collection.
sections.Editions:
